### 1.  Facts

1.1.  A written **Lease/License Agreement** (hereinafter “the Agreement”) was executed between the **Landlord** and the **Tenant** on **[Date of Agreement]**, wherein the Tenant was granted exclusive possession of the premises situated at **[Full Address of Premises]** (hereinafter “the Premises”) for a monthly rent of **Rs _____** payable on or before the **5th day** of each calendar month.  

1.2.  The Agreement expressly provides that failure to pay the rent on the due date shall constitute a breach of contract and shall entitle the Landlord to recover the outstanding amount together with interest, costs of recovery and, if necessary, to terminate the tenancy.  

1.3.  The Tenant has **failed to pay the rent for the months of July, August and September 2026**, amounting to a total arrear of **Rs _____** (Rs _____ each for three months).
